messages:
talia.sre: FYI: planned AZ-2 capacity cutover rehearsal on Fri 02:00-02:45 UTC. This is a controlled traffic rebalancing test (no node terminations). Objective: validate router-weight schedule + KV pre-warm and verify rollback triggers. Please ack and review runbook. :loud_sound:

mike.ops: Ack. I'll monitor GPU scheduling and eviction rates.

julia.observability: I'll increase trace sampling to 2% for routers and enable cache hit panels. Dash link will be posted 15m before start.

talia.sre: Run highlights:
- Shift ~25% gen traffic AZ-2 -> AZ-1 over 8m
- Exclude Dedicated reserved pools and pinned tenants
- Pre-warm top-50 KV prefixes 15m before window
- Rollback if p95 token latency > 280ms for >4m or errors >0.7% for >3m

kevin-oncall: I'll set p95 alert and a schedule pause hook. Use metric redwood_request_token_latency_ms_bucket for p95.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze to AZ-2 01:30-03:00 UTC.

mike.ops: Question: should we tag shifted traffic with X-rehearsal:true?

talia.sre: Yes — add header X-rehearsal:true for observability. Also annotate internal metrics with rehearsal_id=E-2026-0723-az2.

julia.observability: Dash: https://dash.redwood/ops/az2-cutover-rehearsal (will be live ~15m prior).

kevin-oncall: I'll be primary 01:50-03:10 UTC. If rollback doesn't normalize p95 within 8m, escalate to infra@redwood.

talia.sre: Post-run owners:
- kevin-oncall: verify routing and node health
- julia.observability: collect traces and heatmaps for any regressions
- mike.ops: collect node snapshots and scheduler logs
- talia.sre: publish short summary to #sre-status within 3h

mike.ops: :thumbsup:

julia.observability: :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Scheduled event created: AZ-2 capacity rehearsal. ID: E-2026-0723-az2.

talia.sre: Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've reviewed runbook. Calendar invite coming shortly.
